entities.name: Cu(II) Chan-Lam O-arylation
observations: The mixture matches an oxidative Cu(II)-mediated O-arylation of a complex phenolic substrate with phenylboronic acid.
The substrate phenolic oxygen couples to the phenyl group formerly attached to boron, forming an aryl ether; the lactam carbonyl and fluorines remain unchanged.

entities.name: Phenyl ether product
observations: The product is the phenolic substrate converted to its phenyl ether.

entities.name: Cu(II) acetate conditions
observations: Acetate, amine base, dichloromethane, and Cu(II) are auxiliary reagents or medium and are not incorporated into the product.
